title: SuperClawd Guardrail
description: Schema for SuperClawd community guardrail files. A guardrail is an enforced workspace rule that intercepts Claude Code tool calls via PreToolUse hooks. The shape mirrors the exported guardrail payload (identity + enforcement content only, no server-managed state).

description.description: Brief description of what the guardrail enforces

match.description: Conditions that determine which tool calls this guardrail intercepts

action.description: What to do when the guardrail matches: deny (block), ask (prompt the user), or warn (allow with a notice)

message.description: Message shown to the user when the guardrail matches

presetId.description: Optional identifier of the preset this guardrail was derived from

experimental.description: Whether the guardrail is in experimental mode

tools.description: Tool names this guardrail applies to (e.g. "Bash", "Edit", "Write")

pathGlobs.description: Optional glob patterns matched against file paths

commandPatterns.description: Optional regex patterns matched against Bash commands

contentPatterns.description: Optional regex patterns matched against tool input content
